subject.why: Depicts the requested timber-framed inn with red roof, blue shutters, and anchor sign.

category.why: Follows Category 4 with a solid stone quay across the foreground and water backdrop.

clean.why: No text, UI elements, characters, or watermarks present.

framing.why: Building is well-centered with clear margins and an appropriate low-angle view.

colour.why: Warm, vibrant sunset palette with clear separation between subject and sky.

detail.why: Shapes are large and simplified without distracting micro-textures.

style.why: Matches the references with smooth, chunky 3D volumes and a soft satin finish.
